0022600208.text: The Nuggets (5-3, on a two-game winning streak and 3-1 on the road) are 9th in the West and two games back in the Northwest, while the Rockets (7-3, 4-1 at home, on a two-game losing streak) sit 6th in the West and one game back in the Southwest. Denver's injury report includes Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and six players listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions: Aaron Gordon (lower body), Cameron Johnson (ankle), Christian Braun (calf bruise), DeMar DeRozan (back spasms), Jamal Murray (lower leg bruise), and Nikola Jokic (elbow sprain), while Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain), Oscar Tshiebwe (illness), and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Denver won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 129-93 win in Denver on March 11, 2026.
